title: Rollen und Gate Runner
description: Vier Rollen und feste Rechte; unabhängiger Review ohne Schreibrechte. Externe Gate-Konfiguration nicht durch Agenten änderbar. Gate: gezielte Manipulations- und Permission-Negativtests erfolgreich.

evidenceRequirements.description: Four roles (Planner, Builder, Reviewer, Fixer) with distinct permissions documented
Gate Runner configuration external to agent control
Negative tests confirm agents cannot exceed permissions

acceptanceCriteria: Four roles defined with distinct responsibilities and permissions
Gate Runner configuration external to agent control (in automation/schemas/gate.schema.json)
Permission negative tests pass - agents cannot write outside allowedPaths
Manipulation tests pass - attempts to modify gates/schemas blocked
Reviewer role is read-only, cannot modify application code
